title: LSP Metrics
description: Schema for the 'LSP' key inside the unified review-output metrics object.

value.description: LSP-1: net count of runtime type checks (is, as?, as!, type(of:)) after removing framework-forced exceptions
LSP-2: count of contract violations for class inheritance (strengthened preconditions, weakened postconditions, broken invariants)
LSP-3: count of protocol methods implemented with fatalError/crash assertions
LSP-3: count of empty (non-fatal) protocol method implementations
